settings.title: Elevate Your Gaze with Scientific Precision.
settings.description: Nourish, strengthen, and lengthen your lashes with our dermatologically-tested serum. Results visible in just 14 days.

settings.title: Micro-Precision Application
settings.description: The BIOAQUA applicator features a 0.1mm micro-fine brush head, engineered for surgical precision at the lash root. Unlike generic felt tips, our synthetic fibers ensure zero-waste delivery of active nutrients directly to the hair follicles.

settings.title: The Molecular Science of Growth.
settings.description: Our proprietary Nourishing Liquid utilizes a triple-peptide complex that accelerates the anagen phase of the hair growth cycle. Infused with botanical nutrients and pharmaceutical-grade biotin, it creates a protective barrier while stimulating dormant follicles for 3x more density.

settings.title: Uncompromising Quality.
settings.description: Our signature purple packaging isn't just about style—it's a seal of authenticity and pharmaceutical-grade safety.

settings.question: How often should I apply the serum?
settings.answer: For optimal results, apply the serum once daily, preferably in the evening after removing all eye makeup. A single stroke at the base of the upper lashes is sufficient.

settings.question: Is it safe for contact lens wearers?
settings.answer: Yes, our formula is ophthalmologist-tested and non-irritating. However, we recommend removing contact lenses before application and waiting 15 minutes before re-inserting them.

settings.question: What happens if I stop using it?
settings.answer: If you stop use, your lashes will eventually return to their natural growth cycle and previous appearance over the course of several weeks to months.
